title: Combat Extended
description: Server-side combat rebalance and anti-abuse layer for Minecraft combat.
body: Combat Extended is a Minecraft combat rebalance mod that improves tridents, adds cooldowns to totems and bows, reduces crystal/bed/anchor explosion abuse, enhances Multishot crossbows, adjusts miss cooldowns, and improves weapon tooltips. The goal is to make combat more tactical, fair, and less dependent on abusive PvP mechanics while keeping a vanilla-friendly feel.
